children.title: MVP
children.description:
--- Pruned ---
- View project
- Create task
  - User selects an existing task
    - Make nodes clickable/selectable
    - Highlight selected task
  - User provides a title
    - Show text input tied to selected task
    - Send creation request to backend
  - System creates the task
    - Expose POST /tasks with parentId and title
    - Validate request (parent exists, title not empty)
    - Assign auto-incremental ID
    - Insert as child in the in-memory tree
    - Persist updated tree to JSON file
  - Tree re-renders with the new task
    - Re-fetch tree after creation
- Complete task
  - User toggles task completion
    - Show completion control on selected task
    - Allow toggling back (uncomplete)
  - System updates the task
    - Extend Task type with completed field
    - Expose PATCH /tasks/:id with completed flag
    - Validate task exists
    - Update task in the in-memory tree
    - Persist updated tree to JSON file
  - Tree reflects completion state
    - Visually distinguish completed tasks
    - Re-fetch tree after toggling
  - abandonar una tarea
    - cómo el usuario marca una tarea abandonada?
    - diferencia visual entre completada y abandonada
    - abandonada cuenta como done para el X/Y
- Visibility steps as list
  - Extract step detection logic
  - Render steps as indented list
- Relocate task
  - Write use case documentation
  - User selects a task to relocate
  - User selects the new parent
  - System relocates the task
  - Tree re-renders after relocation
- Visual connectors in steps
  - Extract ConnectedList component
  - Refactor steps to use ConnectedList
- Atomic task grouping
  - Separate children into branches and atomics
  - Render atomics with ConnectedList and bordered box
- Delete task
  - User triggers deletion on selected task
    - Show delete button when task is selected (not root)
  - System confirms the intent
    - Compute recursive descendant count for selected task
    - Leaves (0 descendants) require only the initial click
    - Tasks with descendants require N additional clicks (N = descendant count)
    - Show countdown on button: remaining clicks and total tasks to be deleted
    - Cancel confirmation on Escape or selecting a different task
  - System deletes the task
    - Expose DELETE /tasks/:id endpoint
    - Remove task and entire subtree from parent
    - Reject deletion of root task
    - Persist updated tree
  - Tree re-renders after deletion
    - Re-fetch tree after deletion
    - Clear selection if deleted task was selected
- Navigate across a pleasant tree
  - Wire up view toggle in App
  - Implement tree layout algorithm
  - Render nodes as SVG
  - Draw curved connectors
  - Implement pan and zoom
  - Fit-to-view
  - Visual design and hierarchy cues
  - Relocating mode visual feedback
  - Expand/collapse branches
  - Focus mode with breadcrumbs
  - Animated transitions for layout changes
  - Keyboard navigation
  - Minimap
  - zoom out clamped
- Navigation use cases
- que se vean también cuántas tareas no están completadas al colapsar una
- Task ID visibility
  - Show IDs alongside task titles
  - Toggle ID visibility (user decides when to see IDs)
- change navigation in trackpad [NEXT STEP]
  - zoom only when pinching
  - navigation with two fingers without needing clicking
- evitar que el zoom se reinicie todo el rato
- Description of the task
  - Show description only when requested
    - Modify description when it's showing
      - Create a description is just modifying the "empty" desc
  - Toggle showing/hiding descriptions
    - Show the description with gracefully design
      - Show as foreground
      - Lesser importance to the background tree when the description is shown
        - Back to normal importance of the tree when description is not shown
  - A task has empty description by default
  - Add description to the data structure
  - bug: opening with key d begins writhing "d" as the desc
  - press ESC to close open description
- persistencia de la vista del árbol
  - crear otra estructura de datos para la vista del árbol
    - incluir qué tareas están plegadas
      - cuando una tarea es plegada/desplegada, persistir ese estado
      - cargar vista según esa persistencia
        - cargar collapsed IDs desde localStorage al iniciar
      - persistir collapsed IDs
    - guardar opciones tambien
      - guardar hide completed
      - guardar show ids
      - guardar nivel de colapso
      - persistir view mode (classic/v2)
      - persistir show IDs
      - persistir show minimap
      - persistir hide completed
    - usar localStorage como mecanismo de persistencia
    - persistir tarea seleccionada
    - persistir proyecto actual
    - persistir transform (zoom/pan) en V2
- paleta de comandos
  - atajo abrir paleta de comandos
    - overlay paleta de comandos
      - cerrar con tecla esc
  - "Ir a"
    - introducir número de tarea
      - seleccionar esa tarea
        - feedback error si no existe y no hacer nada
- compactar/airear árbol
  - compactar espacio entre diferentes subramas
  - airear para volver a la vista natural actual
- Event sourcing [abandoned]
- crear árbol
  - unificar menú para árboles
    - usar layout similar al de plans
  - elegir un nombre y crer árbol
    - única tarea raíz al crear árbol
- nombre completo de tarea on hover
- types of tasks [abandoned]
  - bug type [abandoned]
  - tarea técnica [abandoned]
